description: Behörde für Stadtentwicklung und Wohnen (BSW): energy datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Behörde für Stadtentwicklung und Wohnen (BSW). Coverage: Behörde für Stadtentwicklung und Wohnen (BSW). The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about energy; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Aktuelle Projekte der Wasserstoffwirtschaft in Stadt und Umland; Fokus- und Schwerpunkträume der Wasserstoffwirtschaft in Stadt und Uml; Ladesäulen und Elektromobilität in Stadt und Umland. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
